notes: Customer: mid-size helpdesk SaaS with large telco & fintech customers; deflection = top metric.
Primary ask: RAG pipeline for support agent autocompletion + proactive deflection on web widget.

Latency SLO: 150ms p95 end-to-end for reranked top-5 responses; soft 100ms p50 target for embeddings lookup.
Quality: care about top-5 precision/coverage for reranker — business needs top-5 to contain correct answer >= 92% during eval.
Embeddings preference: prefer a mix of Open embeddings for quality (fine-tuned) + quantized local model for cost.
Routing needs: region-aware (NA primary, EU customers required EU-hosted), fallback to smaller model if Dedicated capacity saturated.
Cost sensitivity: internal limit ~$0.015/query for combined retrieval+rerank; willing to pay more for guaranteed latency.

Security notes: insist on customer-managed KMS, SOC2 + iso27001 evidence, audit logs for every model call.

Technical ask from SRE: deterministic rerank performance under burst traffic and backpressure handling for KV cache misses.
Suggested pilot: 6-week Dedicated pilot in EU region with controlled traffic, A/B against current boolean search baseline.
SE notes: potential architecture = vpc private control plane + dedicated GPU pool for reranker; secondary region fallback into hosted API.

use_case_requirements: Indexing scale: target 10M documents (tickets + attachments + KB) with incremental daily adds
Throughput/latency: 150ms p95 end-to-end for retrieval + rerank; p50 ~100ms
Reranking: re-rank top-50 candidates to present top-5; metric: top-5 precision >= 92%
Availability: SLA required for Dedicated (99.9%) and audit logs for every request
Model preferences: reranker can be fine-tuned T5-like reranker or cross-encoder; embeddings are high-dim, tested vs text-embedding-3 variants
Fallbacks: lightweight reranker/lexical fallback when GPU pool saturated; automated policy required
poc_results_summary: Ingest: 1.2M tickets ingested, initial vector index built in 24h (single region).
Embeddings: baseline embeddings (3rd-party) + Redwood Optimize quantization reduced size by 4x.
Rerank lift: +18% top-5 metric vs existing tf-idf baseline over holdout set.
Latency: avg retrieval (vector search) = 40ms; cross-encoder rerank on Dedicated GPU = 85ms median, 170ms p95 (just above target).
Cost: modeled at $0.018/query with current POC config; Optimize recommendations expected to push to $0.013-$0.015.
Open issues: p95 rerank latency still 20ms over target; need kernel/compilation tweaks or smaller reranker model for p95 compliance.
